data.name: Grand Prairie Pool Cleaning
data.address: 3040 W Camp Wisdom Rd, Grand Prairie, TX 75052

reviews.text: I recently had Tanner from the pool service team come by my place in Grand Prairie for some urgent repairs on my pool equipment. He arrived quickly and did an excellent job getting my system up and running again by fixing the filter and replacing a broken backwash valve. Tanner also handled some major work on my pool heater, rewiring and replacing the necessary parts to get it working perfectly. I highly recommend this pool company for anything from new pool construction and remodeling to equipment repairs. The service was outstanding!
reviews.author: Aaliyah M

reviews.text: I had new pool pump equipment installed and the service was fantastic from beginning to end. Everyone, from the office team to the technicians like Oliver, was super friendly and acted very professional. The whole process was smooth, and they made sure everything with my pool system was working just right. I would highly recommend Grand Prairie Pool Cleaning to anyone in Grand Prairie who needs help with pool cleaning, repairs, or pump replacements.
reviews.author: debbie cardenas

reviews.text: Grand Prairie Pool Cleaning has helped us with two pools over the years, and each time the experience has been fantastic. Most recently, we wanted a modern lap pool with simple, clean lines and specific features, and that’s exactly what we got. The team’s communication was clear, they scheduled everything on time, and even made a few last-minute adjustments without any trouble. Tanner and Oliver were especially helpful, always making sure our pool cleaning and maintenance needs were taken care of. The whole process went smoothly from start to finish. We’re thrilled with our new pool and the reliable pool service we continue to receive.
reviews.author: Carla Jefferson

reviews.text: i've used tanner at grand prairie pool cleaning several times. he's always on time, professional, and easy to talk to. had my pool heater fixed and got a new multi-speed pump put in. everything works great now. definitely recommend for anyone looking for reliable pool service in this texas heat.
reviews.author: hayley edwards

reviews.text: After dealing with some uneven pavers around our pool, we reached out for help and the warranty team was quick to respond. Everything was fixed and leveled within a few weeks, which was great. Now our pool project is finally finished, and it looks amazing! It’s so nice having a clean and beautiful pool, especially with the hot Grand Prairie weather. The water is super inviting, and we’re just waiting for it to warm up a little more so we can really enjoy it. The team is now working on measuring for the pool enclosure, and we’re excited to see the final results. We’re very happy with how everything turned out and love our new backyard oasis.
reviews.author: Jordan Aguilar

reviews.text: I found Grand Prairie Pool Cleaning online after seeing lots of positive reviews. I reached out and got started with a visit and pool design ideas. Throughout the design phase, we changed our minds a few times, but Tanner was always patient and provided updated 3D designs each time without any trouble. From the beginning to completion, the project took about four and a half months. The team paid close attention to detail and always kept our backyard tidy after each day’s work. The communication was fast and dependable whenever I had questions. The pool pump and heater app are simple to use, and the maintenance crew are both friendly and very knowledgeable about keeping the pool in top shape. Any small items we noticed were quickly fixed within a couple of days. We’re really happy we chose Grand Prairie Pool Cleaning for our pool project.
reviews.author: Mindy Barajas

reviews.text: we had a wonderful experience with grand prairie pool cleaning. tanner did an excellent job fixing our pool light, which had been installed incorrectly by someone else before. he made sure to call ahead just like we asked and arrived right on time. we also trust them to test our pool water and pick up all our pool chemicals and supplies. it's great to have a reliable, local company for all our pool cleaning needs instead of the big chain stores!
reviews.author: Jase Pace

reviews.text: As the maintenance supervisor at an apartment community in Grand Prairie, I work with Grand Prairie Pool Cleaning for all our pool cleaning needs. They are a reliable and high-quality pool service company. We are very pleased with the work of technician Tanner, who always does a fantastic job and clearly knows the ins and outs of pool care. Tanner is passionate about his work and always helps us with any pool issues right away. The supervisor Oliver is also very attentive and always ready to assist when needed. I highly recommend this company for anyone looking for dependable pool cleaning services.
reviews.author: Tyler27 R

data.summary: The Google reviews for the local DFW profile appear largely authentic, with specific details, varied writing styles, and one balanced review. However, the clustering of several 5-star reviews in the same recent month is a minor red flag. The HQ Google reviews are not genuine reviews but appear to be scraped business listings. Overall, the positive reviews seem credible reflections of customer experience.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted within the same month (a month ago)
Some reviews are overly detailed and promotional in tone
HQ Google reviews are all anonymous and contain no actual review text, only business listings

positive_evidence: The warranty team was quick to respond and fixed uneven pavers

authentic_signals: Specific project details mentioned (filter repair, backwash valve, pool heater, pavers, 3D designs)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (homeowner, apartment supervisor)
Mentions of timeline (four and a half months)
One review provides balanced, constructive feedback from a maintenance supervisor
